The task: Move the info from the coastal correlation meetings in Nanaimo to tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class. 
	1.) Pull the latest version of tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class into R.
	2.) Update it using the spreadsheets updated during the Nanaimo meeting (in the External_ Coastal BEC Guide - Associations_Alliances_Review folder).
	3.) Export it back into Access as an update table. 
	4.) Make a copy of tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class  to avoid overwriting it, name it something e.g., Archived_
	5.) Make another copy but copy over the structure only. 
	6.) Append imported data from R into this blank version. 

Source files, load packages: 
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(DBI)

# Source files: 
source("local_paths_DSO.R")

# Pull in Nanaimo meeting spreadsheets:



```

Connect to BECdb, pull out tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class. 
```{r, include = FALSE}
# Connect to latest version of BECdb ("C:\Users\debor\OneDrive - Government of BC\MacKenzie, Will H FOR_EX's files - BECdb_Working\BECdb_ver14_2026_v1.accdb"). This is known as bec.becdb in local_paths_DSO.R

becdb <- dbConnect(
  odbc::odbc(),
  .connection_string = paste0(
    "Driver={Microsoft Access Driver (*.mdb, *.accdb)}; DBQ=",
    getOption("bec.becdb"), ";"
  )
)

BEC.hier <- dbReadTable(becdb, "tblBEC_Hierarchy_Class") %>%
  mutate(SiteUnit = str_replace_all(SU_Label, c("/" = "_", " " = ""))) # Check if this line is necessary or wanted **
```
